messages:
tom: Hey team — final pass on the product launch blog. I pushed the latest draft to GDrive: https://docs.google.com/example. Can folks check claims, hero screenshots, and CTAs by EOD? Need to lock publish window today.
maya: On it. I'll validate the benchmark narrative vs the eval deck and flag any scope creep.
aisha: Design here — can we confirm hero device size? I'll update the GIFs once Tom confirms copy. Need assets by 3pm to meet QA.
ben: Legal — quick flag on the line: "delivers 2x lower per-token cost". What's the measurement? absolute/median? we need source or reword to "up to 2x" + footnote.
tom: Source is the benchmark spreadsheet in Marketing Drive (sheet 'Benchmarks - Apr'). We ran p50 token cost on standard prompt set. I'll add a footnote and/or inline link.
maya: If it's p50, say "up to 2x on typical generation workloads" and link to the public benchmark appendix. avoids overclaim.
nora: For webinar CTA: are we driving to HubSpot form or native registration page? Need to map utm/campaign and SDR routing.
tom: HubSpot form -> campaign=launch-spring26, form id = 5f3a2c. Mapping snippet:
```
hubspot_form: 5f3a2c
utm_campaign: launch-spring26
sdr_queue: launch-apr26
```
nora: I'll wire the automation: new leads tagged `launch-apr26` -> SDR queue -> send nurture 24h after registration. Will confirm by 4pm.
publish-bot: reminder — scheduled publish windows today: 16:00, 17:00, 19:00 UTC. Conflict: 17:00 already reserved by infra blog.
aisha: If 17:00 blocked, can we aim for 16:00? I'll have hero assets ready by 15:15.
ben: From Legal — LGTM if we change claim to "up to 2x" + link to appendix. Also need the data retention note in the privacy section for webinar registrants.
tom: I'll make the wording change and add privacy note. Draft publish checklist:
```
- change benchmark claim to "up to 2x"
- add benchmark appendix link
- attach hero GIFs (aisha)
- add HubSpot form mapping (nora)
- legal footnote + privacy line (ben)
- set publish window (tom)
- final signoff (maya)
```
maya: Approving draft pending the changes above. I can sign off once Ben confirms privacy line.
nora: Leads routing configured, SDR owners tagged, nurture set. Tagging it `launch-apr26` in HubSpot now.
ben: Confirm privacy line: "We collect registration details to contact you about product updates and events. See our privacy policy." — Ben approves with that phrase.
tom: Thanks — I'll update the doc, swap the claim, attach assets, and lock for publish at 16:00 UTC. Will ping in #marketing when locked :party:
maya: Great — thanks everyone.
